name: paranoidal-petrochem
title: Paranoidal Petrochem
author: FactorioParanoidal; chemistry after PetrochemPlus by Pezzawinkle and More Petrochem Hell by Claviduck
description: More chemistry on top of Angel's Petrochem: nitrogen oxides, hydrogen cyanide, phosgene, acetylene and vinyl chloride, PMMA, polycarbonate, ABS and PVC plastics, multi-stage rubber, bioplastic, metal catalysts, a plastic wall and the tetraethyllead fuel additive for high octane enriched fuel. Replaces PetrochemPlus (PCPRedux) and More Petrochem Hell.
